description: Implementation of a Telnyx voice call provider, including methods for initiating, hanging up, playing TTS, transcription, webhook verification, and event normalization.

classes.name: TelnyxProvider
classes.description: A class implementing the VoiceCallProvider interface for Telnyx API integration, handling call control, webhook verification, and event processing.

methods.name: verifyWebhook
methods.description: Verifies the Telnyx webhook signature using Ed25519.

methods.name: parseWebhookEvent
methods.description: Parses incoming webhook event into a normalized format.

methods.name: normalizeEvent
methods.description: Converts Telnyx event data into a normalized event object.

methods.name: mapHangupCause
methods.description: Maps Telnyx hangup cause strings to normalized end reasons.

methods.name: initiateCall
methods.description: Starts an outbound call via Telnyx API.

methods.name: hangupCall
methods.description: Hangs up an active call via Telnyx API.

methods.name: playTts
methods.description: Plays text-to-speech audio during a call.

methods.name: getCallStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a call.
